title: Multi-modal AI for Precision Medicine
description: Integrating multimodal clinical data, including electronic health records (EHRs), physiological signals (e.g., ECG), and multi-omics data, to predict patient health outcomes, assess disease risk, and evaluate drug responses.

title: Graph representation learning for Reasoning in Biomedical AI
description: Developing graph-based learning and reasoning methods to model complex biological relationships, integrate heterogeneous biomedical knowledge, and uncover novel disease mechanisms and therapeutic targets.

title: Large Language Model for Drug Discovery
description: Generative Binder Design: Leveraging transformer-based models and Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) with interaction classifiers to generate and optimize mRNA and other binding partners. Sequence and Expression Optimization: Applying autoregressive transformers and contrastive learning to optimize mRNA and protein sequences for improved translation efficiency, expression, and therapeutic stability in human systems.

title: Knowledge representation, Reasoning, and Design optimization for Manufacturing
description: Knowledge Representation and Reasoning: Developing graph-based representations and reasoning methods to extract actionable insights from complex manufacturing data. Design Optimization: Leveraging generative models and data-driven optimization to improve product design, manufacturing processes, and operational performance.
